sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Physical Wholesale Brokerage of Marine Fuel Oil and Distillates

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United Kingdom Treaty for the Promotion and Protection of Investments (2014)
Colombia–Mexico Trade and Investment Agreement (Pacific Alliance, 2014)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1762 of 2015 (AML/CFT penal and administrative framework), Law 190 of 1995 (statute against corruption), Law 1121 of 2006 (adoption of FATF recommendations), Law 2010 of 2019 (UBO registration mandate), DIAN Resolution 164 of 2022 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUBF), and Circular Básica Jurídica 029 of 2014 (Superintendencia Financiera general AML/CFT rules)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of foreign parent/incorporator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country registry or Secretary of State

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney for incorporation representation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of foreign entity bylaws and board/shareholder resolution authorizing incorporation of the Colombia S.A.S.
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or notary in home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Ultimate Beneficial Owner declaration (Formulario UBO) with ownership chart
Financial capacity statement and bank reference letter for mineral fuel wholesale activity

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, EU sanctions lists, and Colombia's consolidated national list (LaLista UIAF). Politically Exposed Persons (domestic and foreign, current and former) require enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, and senior management approval. The S.A.S. must maintain an AML/CFT risk management system aligned with Circular Básica Jurídica 029 of 2014 and Superintendencia de Sociedades guidelines, including ongoing transaction monitoring and suspicious transaction reporting to UIAF.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – www.rues.org.co, operated jointly by the Cámaras de Comercio and Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Spanish, using the Latin alphabet and Spanish orthographic conventions. For S.A.S. entities, the name may include a fantasy, patronymic, or corporate expression, but must end with the abbreviation 'S.A.S.' Where foreign words are used, they must be transliterated into Spanish phonetics as required by local notary and registry practice, and may not mislead as to nationality, legal form, or regulated activity.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Petróleo (if the name implies state petroleum licensing or unauthorized hydrocarbon refining)
Sociedad Anónima (without a valid S.A. registration)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the incorporator may file a recurso de reposición with the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days after notification, and a recurso de apelación in subsidium with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within 15 calendar days. The registrant must provide the requested clearance certificates for any sensitive token and may simultaneously submit two alternate name proposals to avoid operational delay. Name reservations may be extended only in limited cases specified by each Chamber of Commerce, usually for an additional 30 days upon payment of a nominal fee, subject to availability.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are generally accepted for registered-office purposes under Colombian law, but for the ISIC 4661 wholesale of marine fuel oil and refined petroleum products, virtual-address-only arrangements will likely fail the commercial-substance review of the Ministry of Mines and Energy and are not recommended. A physical local office, a permanent local contact, and evidence of operational capacity for import, storage, distribution, and financial settlement are expected for the hydrocarbon wholesale license. The Chamber of Commerce and tax authorities may reject a purely virtual domicile if the registered activity is classified as high-risk.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High risk; estimated 75% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months of operation, given the energy-commodity trading classification, the requirement for a statutory special license, and the intensified UBO and PEP screening regime.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation certificate (certificado de homonimia) in the Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff set by Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: S.A.S. incorporation notary and registry fee calculation based on authorized capital and selected Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial and registry tariff plus market legal fees for drafting the private incorporation document and obtaining NB001 form

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Translation into Spanish and apostille legalization of foreign corporate due-diligence documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator and Colombian consulate (where apostille not applicable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for official translation and apostille processing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Municipal industry and commerce registration (Registro de Industria y Comercio) preliminary permit for wholesale fuel distributor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory municipal tariff for industrial and commercial registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales) filing and preparation of AML/CFT compliance manual
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN, UIAF, and external legal/compliance advisor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for filing agent assistance and AML manual drafting; DIAN filing itself is without additional fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and commercial substance package (12 months physical address, virtual mail handling, local compliance contact)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for physical office and correspondence handling in Bogotá or Barranquilla

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Special license application for wholesale marketing of mineral fuels, gasoline, diesel, and marine fuel (Dirección de Hidrocarburos, Ministerio de Minas y Energía)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Mines and Energy / designated licensing authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee and technical evaluation contribution for hydrocarbon wholesale license

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Domicile/registered agent service for statutory notifications and service of legal process
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent or S.A.S. legal representative
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for corporate representation and domicile services in Colombia

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada regime), Arts. 1, 5, 9, 17 and 21; Colombian Commercial Code (Decree 410 of 1971), Arts. 352-364 and 110-115; Sole Regulatory Decree 1074 of 2015, Title 1, Chapter 2; Resolution 100-000004 of 2021 (RUES operational standards).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) of the registered office, operating under the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) and the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) containing the corporate bylaws (estatutos), filed for registration in the Mercantile Registry; public deed (escritura pública) is required only when the corporation holds real estate assets.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal capital is required for an S.A.S. The incorporation instrument must state authorized, subscribed, and paid capital; at least one share must be subscribed and paid on incorporation. The remainder of the subscribed capital may be paid in installments within two years (Law 1258 of 2008, Art. 9). No escrow or blocked bank account is required by corporate law. For the wholesale fuel license, the Ministry of Mines and Energy may apply a minimum net worth and working capital test set by Resolution 40137 of 2021.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED unanimously as follows: 1. That the Company is established as a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada under Law 1258 of 2008, and the subscribed shares set forth in the incorporation instrument are accepted, issued, and fully paid in accordance with the terms of payment therein. 2. That the registered office of the Company is established at Calle 100 No. 8-12, Office 801, Bogotá, Colombia, and the legal representative is authorized to record such address with the Chamber of Commerce. 3. That Mr. Carlos Espitia is appointed President and Legal Representative, and Ms. Laura Gómez is appointed Secretary and Compliance Officer, with full powers to execute the incorporation registration, obtain the tax identification number (NIT), open bank accounts, and represent the Company before all governmental, financial, and fuel-licensing authorities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name availability verification and homonymy certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of Bogotá through the RUES online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two alternative corporate names through the RUES 'Certificado de Homonimia' service. The Chamber verifies that the proposed S.A.S. name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company or trademark. Upon clearance, download the homonymy certificate, which remains valid for 30 calendar days, and proceed directly to drafting the incorporation document.
required_dossiers: Completed homonymy request form
Copy of the applicant's citizenship card (cédula) or passport
Power of attorney if filed through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, immediately submit two new name alternatives through the same RUES portal; the rejection notice identifies the conflicting registration, and the applicant may refile without additional charge within the 30-day validity window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the incorporation instrument and share subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary or Chamber of Commerce pre-registration verification; executed by all founding shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish, including all mandatory clauses required by Article 17 of Law 1258 of 2008: company name, domicile, corporate purpose, capital structure, administrator/board structure, officer powers, duration, and dissolution grounds. Each shareholder subscribes and partially or fully pays the subscribed shares; signatures are authenticated before a notary or with notarized signature statements. Prepare the beneficial ownership declaration identifying each ultimate beneficiary owner.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws (estatutos) in Spanish
Share subscription and payment schedule showing authorized, subscribed, and paid capital
Certified identification documents of all shareholders
Beneficial ownership (beneficiario final) declaration form
Notarized statement of authenticity of signatures, if requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber raises corrections, re-submit the instrument with marginal corrections or a clarifying corrective document; no full re-registration fee is charged if the corrected filing is submitted within one month from the notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registry registration and issuance of certificate of existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio – Mercantile Registry (Registro Único Empresarial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation document and accompanying forms through the RUES portal or Chamber window. Pay the registration fee (derechos de inscripción) and the business registration fee (matrícula mercantil) generated by the system. The Chamber performs the legality review, registers the company, and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal together with the business registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation instrument (original and copy)
Valid homonymy certificate
Beneficial ownership declaration
Payment receipt of registration and matrícula fees
Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial (FURE) signed by the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a legal defect is identified, the Chamber issues a notice of correction (prevención); the applicant has one month to cure by amending the instrument or supplying the missing document. The original filing date is preserved once the defect is cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax identification (NIT/RUT) activation and electronic invoicing setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Certificate of Existence, complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) registration to obtain or verify the NIT. Update the RUT with the applicable tax responsibilities: income tax (Régimen 26), VAT (Régimen 07), and industry and commerce tax (ICA). Authorize the electronic invoicing system (facturación electrónica) through DIAN's free portal or a certified software provider. Register the bank account and the high-risk activity due-diligence information required for the wholesale fuel sector.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation issued within the last 90 days
RUT pre-registered in the DIAN portal
Identification document of the legal representative
Proof of corporate bank account
Lease agreement or proof of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: RUT issuance is immediate in most cases; if rejected due to inconsistencies with Chamber data, correct the data first at the Chamber, then re-validate the RUT at the nearest DIAN service center. Any formal denial may be appealed via recurso de reposición within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fuel wholesale commercial license and sectoral registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Minas y Energía – Dirección de Hidrocarburos (VITAL portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application for registration as a wholesale fuel commercializer (comercializador mayorista de combustibles líquidos derivados del petróleo) under Decree 1073 of 2015 and Resolution 40137 of 2021. Demonstrate financial capacity, technical-operational capability, and a corporate purpose expressly covering fuel wholesale. If marine fuel brokerage at ports is planned, secure the supplementary bunkering endorsement from DIMAR and the corresponding port authority. The registration certificate must be obtained before any sales, storage, or transloading activity.
required_dossiers: RUT and Certificate of Existence
Certified bylaws evidencing the fuel commercialization purpose
Financial statements or bank reference letter proving required net worth and working capital
Fire safety certificate (for any storage or transloading site)
Environmental registration or ficha if any storage capacity exists
DIMAR bunkering authorization and port access permits (if applicable)
AML/CFT compliance manual tailored to the high-risk energy trading sector
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry issues an inadmissibility decision or requirement (requerimiento), the applicant has 10 business days to respond with the missing evidence. In special cases an oral argument hearing may be requested. A denial may be appealed through recurso de reposición before the Minister and subsequently challenged before the Administrative Court (Jurisdicción Contencioso Administrativa).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Minas y Energía – Dirección de Hidrocarburos; auxiliary authorities: Agencia Nacional de Hidrocarburos (ANH), Comisión de Regulación de Energía y Gas (CREG), and Dirección General Marítima (DIMAR) for maritime bunkering operations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Comercializador de Combustibles Líquidos Derivados del Petróleo – Actividad Mayorista (Wholesale Fuel Distributor Registration); an additional Bunkering Operating Authorization from DIMAR is required for marine vessel deliveries.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ANLA (Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales) for national-level projects; the regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) is competent for local storage or transfer facilities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II – Mandatory environmental registration (Ficha Ambiental) with the competent CAR and a compliance report; full EIA (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental) is triggered only when constructing fuel storage terminals exceeding 15,000 tons capacity or marine bunkering stations exceeding 10,000 m³ of storage.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per Resolution 0631 of 2015, maximum total petroleum hydrocarbon (TPH) concentration of 25 mg/L in hydrocarbon-contaminated runoff; VOC emissions per Resolution 909 of 2008 capped at 600 mg/m³ for loading racks and transfer points; hazardous waste manifests and cradle-to-grave liability per Law 1252 of 2008; spill reporting obligations per Resolution 033 of 2017.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety clearance referencing NFPA 30 and Colombian fire regulations), structural safety certificate (Certificado de Seguridad Estructural), land-use certificate (Certificado de Uso de Suelo) issued by the Curaduría Urbana, and the mandatory occupational health and safety program (SG-SST) registered with the ARL (Aseguradora de Riesgos Laborales) under risk category III-V. Additional mobile and port access permits from DIMAR and the Superintendencia de Puertos e Transporte are required for waterfront bunkering operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN). Official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional e-filing and e-invoice validation platform: MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado). Customs export declarations and national tax collection are administered by the same authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned S.A.S. obtains its NIT as follows: (1) appoint a legal representative domiciled in Colombia; (2) execute the incorporation deed before a notary and file it with the competent Cámara de Comercio, which automatically generates the provisional NIT; (3) complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) registration with DIAN, activating the responsibility codes for income and complementary tax (ordinary regime), VAT (IVA) at 19%, withholding at source, national fuel tax codes if applicable, and the foreign-exchange settlement registration; (4) obtain an authorized digital signature and e-invoicing certificate (firma electrónica) from an accredited certification entity; (5) register the fiscal address and legal representative in MUISCA. Foreign shareholders must submit apostilled corporate existence certificates and register their shareholding data with the Chamber of Commerce. If the S.A.S. acts as principal exporter of hydrocarbons, it must additionally obtain export authorization from the Ministry of Mines and Energy and DIAN's fuel-export registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The S.A.S. is a Colombian tax resident corporation subject to national corporate income tax at 35% on worldwide income, with a foreign tax credit for foreign-source income. No pass-through or check-the-box classification exists under Colombian law. Territorial scope: modified worldwide taxation, Colombian-source income fully taxed and foreign-source income taxed with credit relief. The operation is not located in a Zona Franca; therefore the special tax-free zone regime does not apply.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not permit US-style check-the-box elections. Available statutory mechanisms include: (a) income tax consolidation filings for Colombian 'Grupos Empresariales' upon DIAN authorization; (b) election to file as a Large Taxpayer ('Gran Contribuyente') with centralized filing and monthly VAT settlement; (c) the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (SIMPLE) regime is statutorily available but is excluded for wholesale fuel brokerage and is therefore unavailable; (d) foreign tax credit is granted by default, with no alternative to elect a deduction once the credit is applied; (e) the VAT export zero-rating election under Article 481 E.T. for qualifying services rendered to foreign beneficiaries without a Colombian permanent establishment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto sobre las Ventas – IVA), a national consumption tax with no sub-national component; a complementary excise (Impuesto Nacional a la Gasolina y al ACPM) applies to producers/importers of fuels, not to brokerage commissions.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no turnover threshold for mandatory VAT registration in Colombia: any S.A.S. performing taxable services or goods sales must register in the RUT and assume IVA responsibility before the first transaction. Registration is mandatory from incorporation regardless of capital or turnover. The SIMPLE regime (available up to 100,000 UVT, approximately COP 472,000,000 in 2024) is statutorily excluded for hydrocarbon wholesale brokerage.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (factura electrónica de venta – FE) through DIAN-validated technology providers; issuance requires prior 'habilitación de numeración' in MUISCA. Each invoice must bear the CUFE/CUDS unique digital code and QR code validated through DIAN's web service; clearance is granted in real time, and non-validated invoices are invalid for cost deduction and VAT crediting. For exports, the electronic export invoice must be pre-submitted to DIAN's export module with the bill of lading attached digitally; fuel sales require special hydrocarbon transaction codes and monthly operational reports to DIAN.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports under Article 481 E.T. are zero-rated (0% VAT) with the right to refund of input VAT, provided the goods are physically exported and covered by a definitive export declaration. Services, including brokerage commissions on crude oil and refined products, qualify only if: (i) the beneficiary is a foreign entity without a Colombian permanent establishment; (ii) the service is economically used abroad; and (iii) the consideration is received in foreign currency and settled through the local foreign-exchange market. In a pure commission mandate, only the principal exporter may claim zero-rating for the goods; the commission is exempt only when the brokerage service is performed entirely abroad. If the S.A.S. acts as principal (buy/resell), title and risk must pass outside Colombia and the S.A.S. must hold the hydrocarbon export registration; otherwise the commission is taxed at 19%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic export invoice (Factura Electrónica de Exportación) validated by DIAN with CUFE code
Customs Export Declaration (DEX – Declaración de Exportación) with definitive acceptance
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill evidencing physical dispatch abroad
Foreign exchange settlement certificate (Certificado de Compra de Divisas) issued by a local intermediary bank
SWIFT MT103 and/or standby letter of credit evidencing receipt of payment
Commercial contract or brokerage agreement, quality inspection certificate, and packing list
Apostilled corporate documents of the foreign beneficiary for service exports
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN's fuel and foreign-trade units automatically cross-check export declarations, e-invoices, and bank FX-settlement records. Failure to repatriate and settle export proceeds within the 180-day term triggers fines of up to 200% of the non-settled amount, plus prohibition on further exporting. False or inflated export zero-rating claims subject the taxpayer to a 100% surcharge plus interest on the under-declared tax, a penalty of up to 300% of the refund improperly obtained, loss of the right to apply for further refunds for the next two taxable periods, and criminal export-fraud prosecution (4–9 years imprisonment, aggravated to up to 12 years for hydrocarbon smuggling). The retroactive audit window is 3 years, extended to 5 years in cases of omitted declarations or exchange-regime breaches.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) as the prudential and banking regulator, and the Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) for customs and foreign trade compliance. The exchange-control regime is principally codified in Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, Banco de la República Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-083, Resolution 8 of 2000 of the Comité de Cambios, and Circular Externa 026 of 2021 and 032 of 2021 issued by the SFC on money-laundering and terrorist-financing risk management.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso operates under a managed floating exchange-rate framework. Current-account transactions, including maritime fuel oil exports, brokerage commissions, and transportation charges, are freely convertible when channeled through the regulated foreign-exchange market, i.e., through authorized commercial banks, finance corporations, or foreign-exchange houses. Capital-account transactions are partially controlled; foreign direct investment in the Colombian S.A.S., foreign loans, and equity contributions must be registered with Banco de la República using Formulario No. 5 (investments) or Formulario No. 6 (external credit). Profit remittance by dividend distribution to a non-resident shareholder is legally permitted after evidence of registration and after the applicable supplementary dividend withholding tax is discharged; the withholding is generally 10% on the dividend paid to non-residents under Article 245 of the Colombian Tax Statute, provided the distributing entity is fully compliant with corporate income tax obligations. There are no restrictive convertibility quotas for physical commodity trade, but each FX transaction must carry the correct statistical purpose code and complete underlying documentation; an incorrect code or a mismatch between the invoice, B/L, payment beneficiary, and beneficiary bank is the principal practical convertibility blocker.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For exports of refined petroleum products and marine fuel oil by wholesale/trading entities (ISIC 4661), the exporter must first obtain the liquid-fuel wholesale commercialization resolution from the Ministerio de Minas y Energía. The customs export declaration (DEX) must classify the merchandise accurately, and the resulting foreign currency must be repatriated and channeled through the regulated exchange market via an authorized domestic intermediary. The mandatory channeling period is 13 months from shipment, and the statutory obligation covers 100% of the net export value after only pre-authorized and fully documented deductions such as freight, insurance, inspection fees, legal commissions, and demurrage. There is no surrender quota requiring the exporter to sell the foreign exchange to Banco de la República; the exporter may retain foreign currency in a permitted domestic foreign-currency account, but title and the channeling evidence must flow through a Colombian authorized intermediary. The bank will demand the DEX, the invoice validly issued under DIAN e-invoicing rules, the bill of lading or warehouse delivery order, and the actual SWIFT credit in order to close the exchange-market Formulario for each export lot.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD-denominated foreign-currency operating account plus dedicated capital-escrow account for equity subscription proceeds
Multicurrency trade-settlement account and COP operating account with LC issuing facilities
Operational account for Standby L/C margin placement and trade disbursements
Operational COP/USD account with dedicated capital escrow and cash-pooling structure
Trade operations account with bilateral LC acceptance and supplier-payment rails

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Colombian exchange-control law requires that export proceeds, trade settlements, and capital injections be routed exclusively through authorized domestic foreign-exchange intermediaries. Offshore electronic money institutions not licensed by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia cannot issue a valid Declaración de Cambio and therefore cannot lawfully serve as the primary treasury rail for the S.A.S.; using an offshore EMI as a collection point for commodity receivables would breach the mandatory channeling obligation and create an AML red flag with tier-1 correspondents. A Colombian-regulated fintech may be used only as an initiating payment channel or as a wallet layer over a tier-1 account, never as the depositary of trade proceeds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a high-risk energy commodity trading S.A.S., physical KYC interviews are required for the legal representative, each ultimate beneficial owner with a 5% or greater interest, and every account signatory. Colombian tier-1 banks do not generally permit fully remote account opening for high-risk special-license entities; they require at least one in-person meeting at the corporate banking premises, often two, and may additionally request videoconference confirmation with foreign UBOs after the in-country meeting. The physical-presence requirement is rooted in SFC Circular Externa 026/2021 and the banks' internal SAGRLAFT policies, which mandate heightened due diligence, board-level acceptance of the client risk classification, and enhanced beneficial-owner verification through DIAN's Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque or multi-layered ultimate beneficial-owner structure in the Colombian S.A.S., including nominee shareholders or a foreign holding company that has not yet been fully identified.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) certificate from DIAN, current certificado de existencia y representación legal from the Cámara de Comercio, notarized share register with full individual identification of every natural-person UBO, apostilled certificates of incorporation and good standing for each intermediate holding entity, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations for the principal individuals, and legally apostilled powers of attorney for any representative signing on behalf of a corporate shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically exposed person (PEP) designations on a shareholder, director, or close associate of the S.A.S.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent source-of-funds and source-of-wealth reports certified by a Colombian licensed public accountant, 24-month bank and brokerage statements showing genuine accumulation of wealth, signed declaration that the PEP holds no active public contracting or official decision-making authority affecting the transaction, enhanced sanctions screening from professional databases, and written consent to periodic transaction monitoring by the bank's compliance area.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering indicators arising from commodity trading, such as invoice values materially inconsistent with freight, survey, storage, and demurrage documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete structured trade file for every transaction: purchase or brokerage agreement, DIAN e-invoice (XML with CÚDI), bill of lading or warehouse delivery order, international inspection certificate, weight and quality analysis by an independent surveyor, storage or terminal confirmation, insurance policy, bank settlement SWIFT MT103, the corresponding DEX, and a copy of any dedicated financial instrument such as an MT760 Standby L/C where used as payment or performance security.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening hits or cumbersome restriction flags involving petroleum counterparties, flag states, or shipping operators.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC license or written legal opinion on the applicability of a general license, verified absence of UN/EU/OFAC sanctions-designated individuals and vessels in a professionally audited screening report, IMO/MARPOL compliance certificates for every nominated vessel, charter-party and insurance documents, and the Ministerio de Minas y Energía's issued wholesale-marketing resolution demonstrating legal authority to trade the relevant liquid fuels in Colombia.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The non-resident shareholder executes the S.A.S. capital contribution by SWIFT MT103 wire to the company's USD-denominated account with a Colombian authorized intermediary; the wire must reference the shareholder corporate name and the exact wording 'Aportes de Capital S.A.S. — Inversión Internacional' together with the internal investment registration number, if previously assigned. Within 20 business days of receipt, the S.A.S. must file Formulario No. 5 with Banco de la República registering the foreign direct investment; the same form is updated upon subsequent capital increases and upon dividend remittance. The bank will verify that the remitter is the registered shareholder, that the account beneficiary matches the commercial registration of the S.A.S., and that the purpose code corresponds to foreign direct investment (not to service payments or loan disbursements); a loan-financed injection requires a separate Formulario No. 6 and a formal external credit agreement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Physical marine fuel oil and distillate settlements are executed using SWIFT MT103 wires for direct supplier payments, with each wire carrying the applicable exchange-control purpose code derived from the underlying DEX or import/export registration; the bank requires the invoice, the delivery evidence, and the beneficiary bank confirmation before release. Where credit enhancement is required, the treasury rail is a commercial letter of credit issued under UCP600 for the documentary trade cycle, or a Standby Letter of Credit issued under ISP98 and transmitted by MT760; the Standby L/C serves as a performance or deferred-payment guarantee to suppliers, shipowners, and storage operators while the principal settlement flows by MT103 against presentation of conformity documents: invoice, B/L, certificate of quality and quantity, and insurance certificate. The Colombian issuing bank will treat each disbursement as part of the Declaración de Cambio, automatically reconciling the outgoing trade dollars with the corresponding customs declarations, thereby preserving full auditability of the foreign trade corridor.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable COP/USD forward contracts with Colombian authorized financial intermediaries, expressly tied to the maturity of underlying export receivables or supplier payment obligations; these forwards are permissible without prior Banco de la República authorization when the counterparty is a licensed local institution.
Plain-vanilla FX swaps between COP and USD for short-term liquidity alignment of operating accounts and Standby L/C margin calls, where the notional quantum is consistent with underlying trade flows.

Limited use of non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed offshore for the COP/USD pair; although internationally available, NDFs are operationally acceptable to the treasury only for non-locally registered subsidiary flows, since a Colombian-resident S.A.S. meets the same commercial need with onshore deliverable forwards that are automatically eligible as exchange-market hedges.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps with licensed investment-grade counterparties, used to hedge multi-year inventory financing or capital-injection debt in foreign currency, provided the hedged notional is documented against the registered foreign exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial registry renewal (Renovación de la matrícula mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce with jurisdiction over the registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31 for the preceding calendar year; no regulatory grace period is granted
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a surcharge of 10% of the renewal fee for each month or fraction of month delay; continued default places the registration in the non-compliant ledger and, after sustained non-payment, the registry may be cancelled (strike-off), causing the entity to lose its capacity to carry out commercial operations and exposing directors to personal liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership annual confirmation (Reporte de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Beneficial Ownership Registry administered with the Superintendencia de Sociedades)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual commercial registry renewal, no later than March 31; any change in beneficial ownership during the year must be filed within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit, or submission of false data in the UBO confirmation, subjects the entity to fines of up to 25% of the renewal tariff for the corresponding annual period; the registry entry is flagged as non-compliant, preventing certificate issuance, share-transfer registrations, and certain foreign-exchange operations; repeated violations can contribute to cancellation of the mercantile registration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) is mandatory when, as of the prior year-end, the company's total assets equal or exceed 5,000 times the Colombian statutory minimum monthly wage (SMMLV) or its gross income equals or exceeds 3,000 SMMLV; or when the company issues public securities; or when shareholders representing at least 20% of voting rights require an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards as adopted under Law 1314 of 2009 and Decree 2420 of 2015: entities classified as Grupo 1 apply full IFRS as issued by the IASB; Grupo 2 entities apply IFRS for SMEs. Given the entity's size and cross-border trading profile, application of full IFRS is expected.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The legal representative must file the UBO annual confirmation together with the registry renewal, attesting that all ultimate beneficial owners (individuals holding 5% or more of the capital, voting rights, or control rights) are correctly identified. Share transfers executed in the previous year must be reflected in the share register and the UBO registry before closing the annual filing; post-renewal changes require submission within 30 calendar days. The confirmation must state each beneficial owner's name, ID number, percentage of participation, and nature of control.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registro de Junta Directiva, if any)
Registered Office and Agent Record (Libro de Registro de Domicilio y Agente)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – USD 1,500 per year depending on city, provider, and requested corporate secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 10,000 – USD 20,000 per certified audit engagement for a medium-sized wholesale broker of marine fuel oil and refined distillates

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Article 240, Estatuto Tributario; Ley 2277 de 2022 maintained the 35% rate for FY2023-FY2025, eliminating the previously scheduled gradual reduction)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No preferential income tax rate exists for fuel wholesale brokerage under ISIC 4661. Applicable relief is limited to itemized deductions: (i) 50% deduction of qualifying investments in research, technological development and innovation (Art. 256-1 E.T.); (ii) accelerated depreciation for tangible productive fixed assets; (iii) 100% deduction of donations to qualifying entities; (iv) nil deemed minimum income (renta presuntiva suspended through FY2025). The 9% preferential rate for new small companies expired and does not apply to a fuel trading S.A.S. The CCH holding company regime requires substantive management activity and is unsuitable for passive treasury functions of an energy trading subsidiary.
